subject: Hosted API pricing approval request — ClearPipeline
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearpipeline.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing question for high-volume forecast

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and the per-token economics. We pulled together a conservative forecast for Q3 and Q4; at peak we're projecting ~12B tokens / month. I'm attaching the forecast.

Given that scale, is there flexibility on Hosted API unit pricing? Our procurement is looking for a committed, multi-month rate; specifically they're asking whether we can get north of a 20% off-list discount if we commit to a 12-month minimum.

High-level context:
- Primary use: document ingestion + 1:1 user chat (low temperature)
- Likely start-of-service: July 1
- Potential expansion: adding embeddings for search in Q4

Can you confirm next steps and who on your side handles commercial exceptions?

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships
ClearPipeline, Inc.

Attachments: ClearPipeline_Q3-forecast.pdf (pdf, 380KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearpipeline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing question for high-volume forecast

Alicia — thanks for the forecast, this is helpful. I looped in Ben (AE) to own the commercial proposal and Marissa from Deal Desk to scope the exception process.

Short answer: we do grant account-level discounts for committed usage, but discounts >20% need an executive exception and a clear committed minimum. Ben — can you put together proposed rate tiers (12/9/6-month commit) and expected ARR, and mark where you think an exec exception is needed?

Alicia — we'll aim to get a written proposal and any required approvals within 3 business days. If ClearPipeline can share a simple committed spend target (monthly tokens or $), that will speed things up.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: exec exception for ClearPipeline — proposed concession

Team — attaching the term sheet and my summary. TL;DR: ClearPipeline projects ~12B tokens/mo (conservative). They want an off-list rate >20% for a 12-month commit. If we win this, we get a strong case study and likely multi-product expansion.

Proposed commercial concession:
- Offer: 25% off list Hosted API per-token usage for first 12 months
- Commit: minimum $1.2M billed over 12 months (monthly usage threshold: 60% of projected tokens)
- Failure to hit threshold: step-down to 10% off list for remainder of year
- Term: 12 months, auto-renew at list price unless re-signed

Rationale:
- Estimated first-year revenue: $1.6M if they hit projection
- High expansion potential: embed search + dedicated capacity in year 2
- Competitive risk: competitor X has offered a similar concession to win a similar account

Attachments: CP_term_sheet_v3.xlsx
HubSpot opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/CP-2027-0011

As this is >20% we need explicit exec approval. Rishi — can you sign off? Marissa, please flag anything I missed from deal desk perspective.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exec exception for ClearPipeline — proposed concession

Received, Ben. Quick notes from Deal Desk:
- Approval path: Commercial exec ok (>20%) + Finance signoff on committed billing schedule + Legal review for rollback language.
- Suggest tightening: require monthly reporting and a quarterly true-up. Add an audit right for usage metrics (read-only).
- If Rishi approves, Deal Desk will issue an approval memo that goes into the contract packet (we'll include the exception code and snapshot of list vs. concession price).

Lauren — any legal flags on the step-down and audit clause? Also advise on DS/PCI or data residency asks if they request dedicated capacity later.

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exec exception for ClearPipeline — proposed concession

Marissa/Ben — legal is OK with the structure but requesting two small edits:
1) Add explicit definition of "monthly usage threshold" with the metric (billable tokens measured per Redwood billing API) and a 10-business-day window for contesting metrics.
2) Make the rollback to 10% off contingent on Finance signoff if the shortfall is less than 15% (i.e., permit a one-time tolerance).

If Rishi approves commercial concession, we can incorporate these edits and issue the redlines.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel — Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exec exception for ClearPipeline — proposed concession

Thanks for the clean summary. I reviewed the financials and the strategic rationale. Approval below:

- Executive exception granted for up to 25% off list Hosted API usage pricing for ClearPipeline for an initial 12-month period, subject to the following conditions:
  * Customer commits to minimum billed spend of $1.2M over 12 months (monthly thresholds documented in contract)
  * If monthly usage falls below 60% of committed tokens for any three consecutive months, pricing will revert to 10% off list for the remainder of the 12-month term
  * Finance must sign the committed billing schedule prior to contract execution
  * Legal edits suggested by Lauren to be included (metrics definition, 10-business-day dispute window, one-time shortfall tolerance)

I am not approving the 30% concession at this time. The 25% concession balances competitive urgency and responsible unit economics. Please finalize the redlines and route to Finance for signoff; once Finance signs, I authorize execution.

Rishi Malhotra
Chief Commercial Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearpipeline.com>, Trevor Mills <trevor.mills@clearpipeline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing question for high-volume forecast

Alicia/Trevor — quick update and next steps.

Good news: Rishi has approved an executive exception for a 25% off-list Hosted API usage rate for an initial 12-month period, subject to the conditions below (this mirrors what Ben proposed with a few legal/finance guardrails):
- Commit: $1.2M billed over 12 months (monthly thresholds to be included in contract)
- Shortfall: if usage drops below 60% of the committed tokens for three consecutive months, price will step down to 10% off list for the remainder of the term
- Finance signoff and legal edits required before countersignature

What we need from you to move to contract:
1) Confirm you can commit to the $1.2M minimum (we can translate to tokens or a monthly schedule)
2) Quick confirmation on onboarding timeline (target July 1)

Once we have that, I'll send the redline to you via DocuSign. For transparency, here's the DocuSign link where the draft will appear: https://www.docusign.com/xyz/CP_offer_20270505

Thanks — excited to make this happen.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
